issues.title: Client-side update of Reference
issues.body:
When a new document has an empty Reference field, our code should inject the newest reference number for that force.

But, the code is currently always updating the Reference.

Note: in the current wargame we're currently using `reference` instead of `Reference` - to avoid this issue.

So, I guess we need to do this:
- for new message code, if there is a `Reference` in the template, but a reference isn't present, insert a `` empty string.  
- in `checkReference`, see if there is an empty string in `Reference`.  If there is, generate a new reference.  Note: we can't check for `Reference === undefined` - since that would return true for templates that don't include a `Reference` field

comments.body: Closing. Superceded by new server-side strategy
